title: One week in Taipei: 9 essential stops
desc: Nine classic Taipei stops for a week-long trip: temples, old streets, night markets, a viewpoint hike and a day trip to Jiufen.

items.title: Longshan Temple (艋舺龍山寺)
items.memo: One of Taipei's oldest temples; pair it with a Taiwanese breakfast nearby.

items.title: Dihua Street (迪化街)
items.memo: Historic street of dried goods, tea shops and old shophouses.

items.title: Chifeng Street (赤峰街)
items.memo: Quiet lanes of indie shops and cafés near Zhongshan.

items.title: Ximending (西門町)
items.memo: Busy pedestrian shopping and street-food district.

items.title: Ningxia Night Market (寧夏夜市)
items.memo: Compact night market known for traditional Taiwanese snacks.

items.title: Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall (中正紀念堂)
items.memo: Landmark memorial hall with a vast plaza; see the changing of the guard.

items.title: Jiufen Old Street (九份老街)
items.memo: Hillside old street; an easy day trip from Taipei.

items.title: Elephant Mountain Trail (象山步道)
items.memo: Short, steep hike with classic views of Taipei 101.

items.title: Raohe Street Night Market (饒河街觀光夜市)
items.memo: Popular night market by Songshan Ciyou Temple; try the pepper buns.
